predicate.label: sells to
predicate.definition: Entity X sells or sold goods, services, property, or transferable rights to buyer Y.
includes: a completed commercial transfer to Y
historical sales including transferable sporting contracts
excludes: Y is the item sold rather than the buyer
ambiguous: a nominal sale whose owner or seller is unresolved
predicate.notes: An explicit sell-to edge can establish the commercial relation without identifying the item; generic give/send does not.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit sell-to or sale-to; a completed commercial transfer to Y; historical sales including transferable sporting contracts. Excludes: ordinary giving or physical movement; a proposed sale without realization; Y is the item sold rather than the buyer. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear seller-versus-item role; proposed or conditional sale; a nominal sale whose owner or seller is unresolved. An explicit sell-to edge can establish the commercial relation without identifying the item; generic give/send does not.

rationale: Explicit sale/weapon-sale is the most coherent specific transaction family amid generic send paths; sending alone does not establish sale.
